title: Natural-Language Policies to Executable Decisions: An Interpretable Large Language Model Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.26124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pricing automation in large-scale tourism is challenging because travel orders are highly unstructured, while pricing policies are complex, rapidly evolving, and inherently open-ended. Traditional rule engines are brittle and costly to maintain, whereas unconstrained LLM agents lack the reliability and auditability required for financial decisions. We present a production-grade LLM-powered pricing system with a strict decision boundary: LLMs perform structured extraction and bounded policy/path selection, while all numeric pricing, including total-price computation, is executed deterministically. Policies are compiled into interpretable condition trees, enabling open-ended support for new clauses and evolving rules without code changes, while exposing auditable artifacts for human-in-the-loop control. Periodic fine-tuning on logged traces further improves tree induction and path matching. Deployed at a municipal state-owned tourism enter

translated_title: 从自然语言政策到可执行决策：一个可解释的大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26124v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大规模旅游中的定价自动化具有挑战性，因为旅行订单高度非结构化，而定价政策复杂、快速演变且本质上开放。传统规则引擎脆弱且维护成本高，而不受约束的LLM代理缺乏金融决策所需的可靠性和可审计性。我们提出一个生产级LLM驱动的定价系统，具有严格决策边界：LLM执行结构化提取和有界政策/路径选择，而所有数字定价（包括总价计算）均由确定性方式执行。政策被编译为可解释的条件树，支持对新条款和演变规则的无代码修改，同时为人类参与控制提供可审计工件。基于日志轨迹的定期微调进一步改进树归纳和路径匹配。该系统已部署于一家市属国有旅游企业。
tldr: 本文提出一个生产级LLM定价系统，通过严格决策边界和可解释条件树，将非结构化政策转化为确定性可审计的决策，实现了开放政策支持与可靠金融决策的结合。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a production-grade LLM pricing system that converts unstructured policies into deterministic, auditable decisions via strict decision boundaries and interpretable condition trees, enabling open-ended policy support while ensuring reliability for financial decisions.
